annotations.title: Price-target check for one product: is the current price at or below target_price?

description:
Price-target check for one product: is the current price at or below target_price?. Fetches one Wildberries/Ozon product (same live chain as /product/info) and compares it with target_price (RUB): below_target (current <= target and not out of stock), current_price, diff_abs/diff_percent, in_stock, the full product object and checked_at. Use it as a paid poll for price alerts. If the product is out of stock with no price it returns 200 with below_target false, current_price null, in_stock false and a note; if no product data can be fetched at all it returns 502 and the payment is not settled.

GET /product/monitor — price $0.005 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

target_price.description: Target price in RUB, a positive number (e.g. 1500 or 1499.90)

url.description: Product page URL: https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/<id>/detail.aspx (also wb.ru, *.wildberries.ru) or https://www.ozon.ru/product/<slug>-<id>/ (also *.ozon.ru)
